subject.title: test(release): harden shared UI and performance proof

question: Must this PR provide an exact-head OpenClaw Kova report, or is the final pinned SHA's green macOS and Ubuntu owner-repository CI sufficient for this internal release-validation change?
rationale: The patch and upstream revision appear correct, but the repository requires real release-path proof and the current proof checks expose no diagnostic OpenClaw performance output.

options.title: Require OpenClaw report
options.body: Wait for redacted exact-head Kova output that visibly demonstrates correct intentional-restart classification and retained-report redaction.

options.title: Accept upstream CI
options.body: Allow merge based on direct source inspection and the exact pinned Kova SHA's green macOS and Ubuntu test jobs.

recommendation.title: Require OpenClaw report
recommendation.body: Wait for redacted exact-head Kova output that visibly demonstrates correct intentional-restart classification and retained-report redaction.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently maintained the OpenClaw performance and exact-SHA release-validation workflow surfaces, making him the strongest available owner for the proof threshold.
